purpose: Additional modern map-control targets for an independent 1870 Mitchell pixel audit. No historic-map transform or historic street geometry reused.
method: Exact named surface-roadway shared nodes; service, path, footway, cycleway, construction, proposed, pedestrian, tunnel and negative-layer ways excluded. Distinct nodes are projected WGS84 to NAD83/UTM16N and arithmetic mean taken; local frame subtracts the stated origin. Way-pair multiplicity does not weight the mean. Both named road families must continue through every node before it is selected.

existing_control_review.street_control.json: Only Canal/Upper Wacker and Franklin controls; modern Upper Wacker has explicit historic-line caveats, so not chosen for new Mitchell fit.
existing_control_review.west_division_spacing_control.json: Derived historical street-spacing measurement, not independent modern intersection nodes; not reused.
existing_control_review.prairie_1904_control.json: Reusable recorded OSM intersections on Prairie/Indiana/Calumet, outside requested modern axes; not needed for this selection.
existing_control_review.gcp/rees_rucker_1849_gcps.json: Fourteen existing modern grid targets noted, but no map pixels, fit, or transformed geometry reused. These new selections mostly fill other rows/columns and retain actual OSM element IDs.

fetch_fallback.fallback: OSM editing API map bounding-box reads; original XML and retrieval URL/time retained.

ambiguities.state_division: Node 102713553 is a real crossing, but North State Street becomes North State Parkway north of Division. The strict exact-name through-route check refuses it; usable only after explicit successor-name adjudication.
ambiguities.halsted_chicago: Current OSM ways at the crossing carry highway=construction (including 56631005, 435655135, 621625475). Excluded, rather than silently using planned/current construction geometry.
ambiguities.western_16th: Node 261237939 is a real T-junction: West 16th Street does not continue through Western under the same named roadway family. Kept in additional_crossings, not the selected two-through-streets set.
ambiguities.western_31st: Node 261120575 is a real crossing/terminus amid Western Avenue, Western Boulevard, 31st Street and 31st Boulevard. Exact West 31st Street does not continue through that node, so no successor-name/parallel-road conflation is made.
ambiguities.ashland_31st: The two shared nodes are staggered; node 5893114044 fails horizontal through-route continuity while node 13375178046 passes. Their mean is retained only as an unselected candidate, pending inspection of the current divided-road arrangement.
ambiguities.cermak: Twenty-second Street was later renamed Cermak Road and widened. The newly measured modern target can constrain a fit only with that later alteration declared; it does not attest the historic centreline.
ambiguities.ashland: The historic map may label the corridor Reuben Street. Modern Ashland geometry is measured here; the historic name equivalence belongs to the map reading, not this coordinate extraction.

numeric_precision_note: Coordinates rounded to 0.01 m preserve reproducible arithmetic, not surveyed centimetre accuracy. OSM positional accuracy, historic street widening, and the map pixel read require independent uncertainty allowances.
capture_availability: Full rawXML captures are audit-only named captures, not repository paths. Their URLs andSHA256 values are retained; exact selected nodes/ways and every referenced neighbor node are shipped in the portable extract. Additional unselected intersections remain candidate metadata only.
